user_query: I'm planning a road trip with my family and want to create a playlist of popular songs in different countries. Can you give me the top 10 songs in Brazil, Turkey, and Finland on a specific date using the Billboard-API? I would also like to search for playlists related to the song 'Almost Lover' on Soundcloud.

TaskList.description: Fetch the top 10 songs in Brazil on the specified date from the Billboard API.
Fetch the top 10 songs in Turkey on the specified date from the Billboard API.
Fetch the top 10 songs in Finland on the specified date from the Billboard API.
Search for playlists related to the song 'Almost Lover' on Soundcloud.
